mozi.oneLineEn: Recasts ethics as universal love and mutual benefit, grounding norms in merit, upward conformity, and Heaven's will.

mencius.oneLineEn: Argues innate goodness via the four sprouts for humane government, centering the people and right versus profit.

xunzi.oneLineEn: Bad nature needs ritual-and-right artifice; rectifying names and ritual-law order desire and social life.

wang-yangming.oneLineEn: Innate knowing needs no outer search; unity of knowing and acting rewrites ge-wu as extending liangzhi to things.

zhu-xi.oneLineEn: Investigation of things makes Heavenly principle learnable, joining knowledge-action with the ruler's rectified mind.
keywordsEn: Collected Commentaries on the Four Books

hu-shi.oneLineEn: Vernacular writing plus bold hypothesis and careful proof turns tolerance of criticism into public trial-and-error.

liang-shuming.oneLineEn: Compares Chinese and Western cultures by directions of will, rebuilding social order through rural ethics and education.

mahavira.oneLineEn: Makes non-harm the ethical core; right view, knowledge, and conduct with many-sidedness clear karma toward release.

nagarjuna.oneLineEn: Dependent arising as emptiness dissolves own-being; reductio keeps conventional truth and a path to release intact.

vasubandhu.oneLineEn: Five-aggregate continuity explains no-self; ālaya-vijñāna and three natures account for appearance and release.

adi-shankara.oneLineEn: Brahman-ātman identity plus superimposition of ignorance explain bondage; release rests on knowledge, not action-heaps.

ramanuja.oneLineEn: A qualified supreme God encompasses souls and world; devotion and surrender open intimacy of liberation.

tagore.oneLineEn: Religion as the finite self realizing the infinite in love and creation, while criticizing exclusive nationalism.

gandhi.oneLineEn: Experiments with truth and nonviolence turn politics into self-rule, reforming society through a constructive program.

ambedkar.oneLineEn: Exposes caste's religious authority structure and seeks equal citizenship through social democracy and a new Buddhism.

krishnamurti.oneLineEn: Rejects sectarian authority and fixed paths; choiceless awareness dismantles the self built in psychological time.

dogen.oneLineEn: Practice and realization are one; just sitting and being-time let Buddha-nature appear in present practice.
keywordsEn: Treasury of the True Dharma Eye

nishida.oneLineEn: Pure experience precedes subject-object split; logic of place and absolute nothing rewrite self and reality.

watsuji.oneLineEn: Rebuilds ethics from the dual structure of ningen and explains shared historical life through climate and culture.

toegye.oneLineEn: Principle-led four sprouts explain moral emotion; reverence and the Ten Diagrams unify royal knowledge and practice.

yulgok.oneLineEn: Principle and qi inseparable, virtue formed in temperament; sage learning joins cultivation with statecraft reform.
